bio.text: Charles Allen has represented Ward 6 on the Council of the District of Columbia since January 2015 and chairs the Committee on Transportation and the Environment.
He previously chaired the Committee on the Judiciary and Public Safety for three Council periods and has served as Chair and Vice Chair of the Metropolitan Washington Council of Governments.
He graduated from Washington and Lee University, holds a Master of Public Health from the University of Alabama at Birmingham, and lives in Northeast DC with his wife and two children.
